name: reply_complete_held
note: complete, but the line stays low: the master would find the slave absent (S-09.011)

name: reply_complete_rearmed
note: complete, then ready again before PB15 rose: ready for a session while the master is in one

name: reply_feed_stall
note: the feed stopped part-way; the line stays high and the master is held until its wait runs out

name: reply_feed_stall_rearmed
note: the slave gave up and made itself ready again: the master would clock the rest into a new session

name: reply_cut_short
note: the master ended the session one word early; the slave could still move the next word

name: reply_none_held
note: nothing sent; the line stays high

name: request_rx_short
note: a 0x2B write of 0x40 bytes that the master ended one word short; the slave was ready for it

name: request_rx_stall_rearmed
note: received one word short, then ready again before PB15 rose
